t: Beyond DOM: Capturing Full Web Page Context with Selenium Automation
s: This article explores advanced web crawling techniques using Selenium, focusing on capturing comprehensive page context beyond just the rendered DOM, such as HTTP headers and original source, with a deep dive into WebDriver BiDi as a modern, standardized solution.
sub: Web scraping challenges: DOM vs. full context capture
Filesystem transparency for crawl data storage
WebDriver BiDi for network interception and response data
Comparing Selenium's JavaScript API vs. WebDriver BiDi for headers
